doc.title: Orrin Keepnews — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Brown thanks Keepnews on behalf of the Smithsonian and the NEA and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Anything else you’d want to have on the historical record?
No. I think we covered…Well you brought in a nice, big theoretical chunk there, which I hope you allow to survive. That’s the only problem, if you don’t edit yourself out.

Well, I just want to say again, on behalf of the Smithsonian Institution and the National Endowment for the Arts, I just want to express our gratitude for your achievements, and your accomplishments, and this opportunity to be able to spend to this time with you so that we can make sure that the public is continually, and forevermore, made aware of you contribution to this music.
Well, now I’ll have a hard time keeping alive! (Laughs) I’ve done it! Thank you. ### END OF INTERVIEW Transcribed by Kyle Kelly-Yahner
